description: Align layers by their top, vertical centre, bottom, left, horizontal centre or right edges (Layer > Align), or distribute them evenly by those edges (Layer > Distribute; three or more layers). With toSelection, align them to the selection (Layer > Align Layers To Selection)

distribute.description: Distribute instead of align. Default false

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

toSelection.description: Align to the current selection. Default false; Photoshop aligns to a selection whenever there is one, so without toSelection the call refuses when something is selected

name: align_layers
title: Align Layers
